General

1.

After the running of Race 6, the track classification was officially changed from "Good” to "Good to Yielding”. After the running of Race 9, the track classification was officially changed from "Good to Yielding” to "Good”. This change in the opinion of the Stewards should be recorded as being retrospective. As a consequence of this, the official results will show Race 9 being run on a track rated "Good”.

2.

Assistant Trainer C S Yip, allocated to Mr C H Yip’s stable, was fined the sum of $10,000 under Rule 155(5) for improper conduct in that he improperly used a padded whip on a racehorse at the Conghua Racecourse on Monday, 18 August 2025 as he attempted to lead the horse into the trotting ring. Expert Work Rider Ranveer Singh was also cautioned in relation to his whip use on the horse when he was mounted on it. Mr Singh and Mr C S Yip were advised that a report would be made to the Head of Dual Site Stables Operations in respect to their conduct.
